newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares climb in late rally, more gains on.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares climb in late rally, more gains on.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Monday defying predictions of more correction, after a late rally fuelled by interest in Moeller shipping paper, with dealers expecting prices to hold or rise slightly on Tuesday.
"The main reason for the closing rise was late afternoon interest in Moeller aided by the strong dollar. Tomorrow should be a little busier with possible modest gains," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 1.31 point to close at 190.60 The KFX August future fell 1.42 point to 188.98 with 298 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Moeller's D/S Svendborg put on 15,000 crowns to finish at 430,000, while twin share D/S 1912 ended the day 8,000 up at 298,000 crowns.
Also enjoying a good day was FLS Industries, which put on 25 to end up at 270.
After a string of days with notable gains, SAS shed 2.5 crowns to close at 112, hit by profit-taking.
Overall turnover for the day was 927 million crowns.
